title: Department of Energy holds both UFO secrets and the Human Genome Project
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Department of Energy holds both UFO secrets and the Human Genome Project, about 1990s-present at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And while the Department of Energy per the UFO nuclear connection likely holds a lot of secrets when it comes to unidentified flying objects and their reverse engineering, they also conducted the human genome project.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that the Department of Energy, the US government agency in charge of nuclear weapons and national science labs, probably holds many secrets about UFOs and about efforts to copy their technology, because of a link he sees between UFOs and nuclear sites. He points out that the same agency also ran the Human Genome Project, the 1990s effort to map all human DNA. He raises it to suggest that one agency may sit at the meeting point of UFO secrecy and human biology.
